title: Elf Bar Plus50 Kiwi Passionfruit Guava Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: Kiwi Passion Fruit Guava from the Elf Bar Plus50 pod range brings together three bold tropical flavours in one intensely fruity vape. Sharp Passion Fruit meets mellow Guava and tangy Kiwi for a bright, juicy profile with tropical depth and an exotic twist. Each Plus50 pod is prefilled with 2ml of 20mg Nic Salt and topped up via a separate 10ml refill tank for extended use. These pods are designed for the Elf Bar Plus50 Kit and deliver discreet vapour and rich flavour via an integrated mesh coil, ideal for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping.
